sign.digital_hint: Generates a key pair and self-signed certificate on your device; nothing is uploaded. Adobe/UPDF show "untrusted" because it is not CA-issued.

guide.title: Quick guide
guide.welcome_body: Everything runs on your device — files never leave your machine.
guide.start_body: Drag a PDF or images anywhere on the page — the app suggests the right tool. Or open a tool directly and pick a file there.
guide.tools_body: Merge, split, reorder, rotate, extract pages, remove pages, compress, PDF→images, images→PDF, encrypt, metadata, sign, fill forms, OCR.
guide.ai_body: Extract text from scans with an AI model running on your GPU. The model (~650 MB) downloads once, stays on your device, and can be deleted anytime in Settings → Storage. Prefer not to? Tesseract works instantly with no download.
guide.privacy_body: 100% on-device processing — nothing is uploaded, no account needed, and every tool works offline.
guide.settings_body: Manage storage (AI model, OCR data), benchmark your GPU/CPU, switch light/dark theme and language.
guide.desktop_body: The Windows/macOS/Linux app checks for updates on its own; every save opens the native Save-As dialog so you pick where files land.

settings.title: Settings
settings.storage_intro: Only data owned by PDF Toolkit is listed. Each row's size states its source (manifest ∩ cache, or directly measured).
settings.quota_line: {{usage}} used / {{quota}} browser quota for this site
settings.row_ai_model_hint: Source: manifest ∩ cache — total bytes of fully downloaded model files.
settings.row_ocr_assets_hint: Cache API store pdftoolkit-ocr-v1 — tesseract core + tessdata. Deleting this row also removes the extracted copies below so the next run truly re-downloads.
settings.row_ocr_idb_hint: Tesseract's gunzipped traineddata copies. Deleting only this: the next run re-extracts from the cache, no download.
settings.row_precache_hint: The web app copy used offline. Deleting unregisters, clears and reloads the page.
settings.precache_offline: Offline — cannot clean now (the app could not open until you're back online)
settings.in_memory_note: Zip/thumbnail data lives in browser memory and frees when the tab closes — no other background cache exists.
settings.unknown_title: Data not owned by this app
settings.unknown_hint: These stores share the origin but are not managed by PDF Toolkit (shared github.io origin). Display only — no delete.
settings.tier_gpu-strong: Strong GPU — AI OCR runs fast
settings.hw_no_bench: Never measured — run a 2-page AI OCR to get a real number.
settings.hw_stale: GPU configuration changed since the last measurement — re-measure recommended.
settings.hw_remeasure_needs_model: Download the AI model first (OCR tool page).
settings.gpu_missing: Selected GPU no longer available — using automatic ({{label}})
settings.gpu_apply_hint: Applies without an app restart — the model reloads onto the chosen card.
settings.gpu_busy_error: The AI engine is running — apply is disabled until the job finishes.
settings.gpu_measure_mismatch: Note: the engine ran on {{actual}} instead of {{expected}} — the record was keyed to what actually ran.
settings.gpu_force_hint: Windows may hand the app the integrated card regardless of this choice. This toggle launches the app with a flag requesting the discrete card — it may have no effect on older runtimes, and if no discrete card is found the AI engine is disabled (a revert button appears below).
settings.gpu_force_suggestion: Windows may be limiting the app to 1 card — try forcing the discrete card.
settings.gpu_force_recovery: The force-dGPU toggle is ON but no discrete card was found — the AI engine is disabled. Turn the flag off to restore WebGPU.
settings.gpu_windows_note: Windows can still route the app to a different card (Settings → System → Display → Graphics → add PDF Toolkit / the WebView2 runtime → High performance). The app can only REQUEST an adapter — the honest status line says what was requested, never what the OS delivered.
settings.updates_idle: Press check to look for a new version — no app restart needed.
settings.updates_uptodate: You are on the latest version.
settings.updates_available: A new version (v{{version}}) is available — download and install progress shows in the banner.
settings.updates_installing: Installing — the app will restart itself.
